headline: Claude Code capability generates security concerns across healthcare vendor ecosystem
body: Anthropic's Claude Code feature is driving significant velocity in developer communities, with security incidents already documented including breach scenarios involving competing AI platforms. For healthcare organizations evaluating AI vendors, this signals the need for immediate clarification on code execution capabilities, data isolation protocols, and liability frameworks before integration into clinical workflows. Healthcare IT leaders must audit which vendors grant code-generation models direct system access and establish contractual guardrails around EHR connectivity. The vendor landscape is moving faster than governance frameworks can accommodate, creating compliance risk for health systems deploying these tools in production environments. This represents a critical validation checkpoint for healthcare AI procurement and implementation strategy.
